name: Barramundi
desc: Predatory fish of estuaries and rivers that eats smaller fish, crustaceans and molluscs. Mangrove and tidal areas are used for breeding and feeding.
about: The barramundi, Asian sea bass, Asian sea lates, giant sea lates, or giant sea perch is a species of catadromous fish in the family Latidae of the order Carangiformes.
